# XAUBOT Pro - Automated Gold Trading Bot

> XAUBOT Pro is a fully automated XAUUSD (Gold) trading bot for MetaTrader 5. It uses a proprietary algorithm to trade gold during optimal market windows, delivering consistent returns with dynamic risk management.

## Product Overview

- **Product**: XAUBOT Pro - Automated Gold Trading Algorithm
- **Price**: $97/month (cloud-hosted subscription)
- **Platform**: Cloud-hosted (web dashboard, any device)
- **Instrument**: XAUUSD (Gold vs US Dollar)
- **Website**: http://74.50.87.77

## Verified Performance (20-Month Backtest: June 2024 - February 2026)

- Total Profit: $21,309 (at $100 risk per trade)
- Return on $10,000: +213%
- Win Rate: 29.9%
- Profit Factor: 1.70
- Total Trades: 435
- Profitable Months: 20/21 (95%)
- Average Monthly Profit: $1,015
- Maximum Drawdown: $1,293
- Recovery Factor: 16.5x
- Average Reward-to-Risk: ~4:1

## How It Works

1. The algorithm analyzes XAUUSD price action during specific low-volatility market windows
2. Identifies high-probability reversal zones using proprietary calculations
3. Places pending orders with predetermined stop-loss and take-profit levels
4. Uses dynamic position sizing to maintain consistent dollar risk per trade
5. Maximum one trade per day - quality over quantity
6. Fully automated - no manual intervention needed

## Features

- Fully automated XAUUSD cloud trading algorithm
- Premium dark/light theme web dashboard with real-time monitoring
- 6 dashboard tabs: Overview, Performance, Trade History, Settings, Subscription
- Public live results page showing verified performance
- Dynamic lot sizing based on user-defined risk per trade
- Win/loss charts, monthly P&L breakdown, equity curve
- CSV export of trade history
- Works with 30+ MT5 brokers (Exness, XM, IC Markets, Pepperstone, etc.)
- AES-256 encrypted credential storage
- 3 free trades trial to test the system
